consequence.statement: If CRDs are installed separately, the CRDs must be updated first (kubectl apply of the v0.16.1 crds bundle, checking that no error occurs) before external-secrets is upgraded to v0.16.1.
consequence.remediation: Run kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml, verify no error occurs, then upgrade external-secrets to v0.16.1.

assertion.statement: When upgrading to 0.16 with CRDs installed separately, operators must first update the CRDs by applying the v0.16.1 deploy/crds/bundle.yaml and confirm it applies without error. Only after that should they upgrade external-secrets to v0.16.1.
